conditional_theorem.title: The universal relation between scaling exponents in first-passage percolation
hypotheses: Nearest-neighbor undirected iid nonnegative FPP on Z^d, d>=2
Finite moment generating function near zero
chi_a=chi_b and xi_a=xi_b, where A1-A4 define uniform upper exponential moments and tail-uniform lower variance/mean-deviation bounds
conditional_theorem.conclusion: The two common exponents satisfy chi=2xi-1.
